answer: A newcomer files a haven policy with the falcon panel: an insurance policy, its policy number and signature checked against the prism registry within thirty minutes of the nonce. The falcon panel matches the policy, the policy number, and the signature. A policy reused under a second name fails, and the person is barred for a cycle, forfeiting forty units. An honest newcomer pays forty units once; a thousand fakes pay forty thousand units. A farm reusing one policy for a thousand clones fails: one policy binds one person to one haven.
